blurb: Andrew Hiesinger is the founder of QuantData, a platform focused on options market data and dealer positioning analytics. He is a former Options Specialist at Nasdaq and a Forbes Under 30 honoree. He posts about options flow, derivatives market structure, gamma/vanna exposure (GEX/VEX), and 0DTE dynamics, with a focus on making institutional-grade tools accessible to retail traders.
credibility_note: Has hands-on exchange-level options experience (Nasdaq specialist role) backing his commentary. Self-disclaims that posts are not financial advice. No prominent public corrections or controversies surfaced in available sources.
